# rwbjee — WBJEE Companion

> rwbjee.com is a free, community-built companion website for WBJEE (West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination) aspirants. It is NOT affiliated with the official WBJEEB. For official information, visit https://wbjeeb.nic.in/

## Overview

rwbjee.com helps WBJEE students in West Bengal, India make informed college admission decisions. It provides a free college predictor, historical cutoff data (2022–2025), a college directory, important dates/timeline, a blog, and community links — all in one place.

- **Live Site**: https://www.rwbjee.com
- **Reddit Community**: https://www.reddit.com/r/wbjee/
- **Discord**: https://discord.gg/pTTKPYryDp
- **Developer**: https://www.reddit.com/user/rizzz6/

---

## Key Features

### 1. College Predictor (`/predictor`)
Enter a WBJEE rank and get instant, real-time college admission predictions.
- Predictions based on historical cutoff data from 2022–2025 across all categories (UR, OBC-A, OBC-B, SC, ST)
- Smart filtering by branch, category, location, and college type
- Favorites system: save and compare preferred colleges
- 17,000+ data points for comprehensive predictions

### 2. Cutoff Finder (`/cutoffs`)
Browse and search historical WBJEE closing and opening ranks (cutoffs) across all colleges and programs.
- **Desktop**: Loads the full dataset (106 KB compressed) for instant, 0ms client-side search
- **Mobile**: Progressive/lazy loading — fetches data per college on demand (~5–33 KB each)
- Filter by: college, program/branch, year (2022–2025), category, counseling round, seat type
- Data covers 17,179 individual cutoff records

### 3. College Directory (`/colleges`)
Browse profiles of 138+ WBJEE-participating engineering and pharmacy colleges.
- Individual college pages at `/colleges/[slug]`
- Information includes: fee structure, programs/branches offered, placement stats, facilities
- Indexed and filterable

### 4. Timeline & Important Dates (`/timeline`)
A chronological schedule of the WBJEE 2026 exam cycle:
- Exam dates, admit card release, result announcement
- Counseling rounds and schedule
- Registration deadlines

### 5. Blog & Resources (`/blog`)
Articles, guides, and announcements for WBJEE students.
- Content managed via Payload CMS
- Individual post pages at `/blog/[slug]`
- Topics: preparation strategies, counseling guides, college reviews, WBJEE news

### 6. Community & Socials (`/socials`)
Links and integration with the r/wbjee community:
- Latest posts from the r/wbjee subreddit
- Discord server invite
- Reddit and social links

### 7. FAQ (`/faq`)
Answers to common questions about WBJEE, the predictor tool, and how to use the site.

---

## Data & Accuracy

- **Data Source**: Official WBJEE cutoff data published by the West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)
- **Coverage**: Cutoff data from 2022 to 2025 (4 years), 17,179 records
- **Colleges**: 138+ engineering and pharmacy colleges
- **Update Cycle**: Data is updated after each WBJEE counseling cycle
- **Disclaimer**: The predictor is based on historical trends and is a guide, NOT a guarantee. Always verify with official WBJEEB announcements.

## Technical Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19, TypeScript 5
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion 12
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **CMS**: Payload CMS 3 (for blog posts, colleges, site settings, timeline events)
- **Caching**: Upstash Redis
- **Hosting**: Vercel (Edge Network, Brotli compression)
- **Media**: AWS S3

### Adaptive Data Loading Strategy
The cutoff and predictor tools use a device-aware loading strategy:
- **Desktop**: Downloads the full compressed dataset (106 KB Brotli) once → 0ms instant filtering with no further API calls
- **Mobile**: Downloads a 5 KB college index first → fetches individual college slices (~5–33 KB) on demand

### Cutoff Data Format
Data is stored in a custom Flat Columnar JSON format for 88% size reduction (911 KB → 106 KB):
- Lookup tables deduplicate college/program names
- Integer arrays store indices and rank values
- Instantly decodable client-side with no binary format

| Collection | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `colleges` | 138+ WBJEE colleges with name, slug, location, fees, programs, placements |
| `collegeCutoffs` | Cutoff records (opening/closing ranks per program, year, category, round) |
| `posts` | Blog articles with rich text, author, tags, and slug |
| `timeline` | WBJEE exam cycle events with dates and descriptions |
| `siteSettings` | Global site configuration |
| `media` | Uploaded images and files |

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is rwbjee.com the official WBJEE website?**
No. This is a free community resource. For official updates, visit https://wbjeeb.nic.in/

**Q: How accurate is the college predictor?**
It uses historical cutoff data from 2022–2025 to estimate admission chances. While highly accurate for trends, actual cutoffs vary each year. Use it as a guide, not a guarantee.

**Q: Is the college data up to date?**
Yes. Fee and placement stats are updated for the 2026–2027 session based on the latest available reports.

**Q: Is the site free to use?**
Yes, all tools on rwbjee.com are completely free.

**Q: What categories are supported in the predictor?**
UR (Unreserved), OBC-A, OBC-B, SC (Scheduled Caste), ST (Scheduled Tribe), and other WBJEE-recognized categories.

**Q: What is the data source for cutoffs?**
Official WBJEE cutoff data published by the West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) after each counseling season.
